description: Fetch the original-language text of one Bundesrecht konsolidiert document directly by its RIS document id (e.g. "NOR40229402"), as returned by at_search_legislation or at_get_provision — use this to re-fetch a known document's text without re-resolving its citation. Paged via text_offset/text_has_more/text_next_offset. Source: Bundeskanzleramt (Austria), Rechtsinformationssystem (RIS), Bundesrecht konsolidiert.

text_offset.description: Character offset for paging long text (default 0).

name: at_get_legislation_document
title: At Get Legislation Document
